text.p: Herewith provisional calendar for the sale in April of the state's remaining 10 percent stake in Spanish energy group Repsol, according to sources close to the privatisation.
Included is also a list of directors and offer conditions, also from market sources.
April 4 : Registration of prospectus
April 7-21 : Time period for provisional buy orders April 10-11: Spanish promotional tour April 14 : Book-building period begins
April 14-18: European promotional tour April 21 : Maximum retail price to be fixed
April 21-25: Time period for institutional sales and for
irrevocable orders
April 28 : Institutional and retail price fixed
April 29 : Operation liquidated
Global coordinators: BBV Interactivos, Goldman Sachs y Santander Investment.
Directors:
Spanish market: La Caixa, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV), Banco Central Hispano and Banco Santander, according to market sources.
United Kingdom: Banco Santander and SBC Warburg.
Continental Europe and the rest of the world: BBV, Paribas.
United States: Goldman Sachs.
** Conditions (subject to verification):
- Four percent retail discount
- Ten percent discount for employees
- Pro-rated awards without minimum number of shares
